Allerød is a Danish municipality whose healthcare data is tracked in the national clinical quality reporting for atrial fibrillation treatment. According to the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), Allerød is one of 98 municipalities analyzed to support local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. Specifically, Allerød's data on stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant therapy [^src1]. The municipality's specific performance metrics for this indicator are detailed in the report's comprehensive municipal breakdown [^src1].
